title: Embedded call configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $S$ and $H$ be state types, and let $k$ and $l$ be natural numbers. Given an injection from the $k$ work-tape indices into the $l$ indices, a map from $S$ to $H$, tape contents and head positions for the $l$ tapes, and a configuration on $x$ with $k$ work tapes and states in $S$, the embedded call configuration is the configuration with $l$ work tapes and states in $H$ obtained by embedding the emitting configuration using the given tape data and mapping its state by the given map.
